# Accessibility

I want these projects to be usable by everyone, including people who rely on screen readers, keyboard navigation, high contrast or larger text.

## What this covers

Most of my repositories are command line tools, self-hosted services, stream overlays and ESP32 firmware. Accessibility matters most where people actually look at something: the overlays and widgets, the desktop apps and the documentation.

## Known limitations

Stream overlays are visual by design and lean on animation and color. Hardware projects have no assistive features. If a project has limitations beyond that, its README says so.

## Reporting a barrier

Open an issue in the repository and tell me what you were trying to do, what got in the way and what you use (screen reader, browser, operating system). I treat accessibility reports like bugs.
